The elections coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, an [[2024 United States Senate election in Ohio|election]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]]. The primary elections took place on March 19, 2024. {{Horizontal TOC|nonum=yes|limit=2}} == Background == During the [[2020 United States redistricting cycle|2020 redistricting cycle]], the [[Ohio State Supreme Court]] ruled that the congressional district maps enacted by the Ohio Redistricting Commission were illegal gerrymanders that unduly favored Republicans, violating the [[Constitution of Ohio]]. Nevertheless, the 2022 elections took place using those districts, as the Court determined that it did not have the authority to impose a new map itself. It ultimately dismissed the case, ending any possibility that the maps would be redrawn for the 2024 elections.{{cite news|last=Wang|first=Amy B.|date=September 7, 2023|title=Ohio Supreme Court dismisses challenges to GOP-drawn map ruled unconstitutional|newspaper=Washington Post|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2023/09/07/ohio-redistricting-map-unconstitutional/|access-date=September 9, 2023}} == Overview == Both Democrats and Republicans held their ground in the election, securing every seat they won in 2022.{{cite web |title=Ohio House election results |url=https://www.politico.com/2024-election/results/ohio/house/ |website=Politico |access-date=23 December 2024}}{{cite web |title=Ohio House Results 2024 |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-elections/ohio-house-results |website=NBC News |access-date=23 December 2024}} Republicans performed the best in the 2nd district, which has the state's highest percentage of white voters.{{cite web |title=What Redistricting Looks Like In Every State - Ohio |url=https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/redistricting-2022-maps/ohio/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210809104008/https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/redistricting-2022-maps/ohio/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=August 9, 2021 |website=FiveThirtyEight |access-date=23 December 2024}} It was also Donald Trump's strongest in the presidential election;https://opoliticsguru.github.io/2024-Presidential-Election-Results-Ohio/#6/42.253/-77.783 however, Representative-elect David Taylor still outran him by 0.2%. Conversely, Democrats performed the strongest in the Black-plurality 11th district, which was also Kamala Harris's best.{{cite web |title=Congressional District 11, OH |url=https://datausa.io/profile/geo/congressional-district-11-oh |website=datausa.io |access-date=23 December 2024}} Democrats improved{{efn|As candidates not affiliated with either of the two major parties participated in elections in both 2022 and 2024, two-party margin swing is used as a measure of improvement}} on their 2022 results in ten districts, while Republicans gained ground in the other five: {{ushr|Ohio|5|OH-05}}, {{ushr|Ohio|7|OH-07}}, {{ushr|Ohio|9|OH-09}}, {{ushr|Ohio|13|OH-13}} and {{ushr|Ohio|14|OH-14}}.{{cite web |title=Ohio U.S. House Election Results 2022 |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2022-elections/ohio-house-results/#summary |website=NBC News |access-date=25 December 2024}} Republicans made a large gain in OH-09, where they slashed Democrats' lead from 13.2% to a tiny 0.7% but failed to flip the district.
